answer: Harberger-tax bond: each identity prices its plot at 1,000, posts the price on the public beacon, and pays 50 an epoch. Anyone may buy at the posted price, so a lowball gets bought out and a high one pays heavy tax. A raven brings the buyout notice. 1,000 fakes pay 50,000 tax an epoch against a 40,000 reward pool. The delta between posted and true price is the forger's loss either way. An honest agent posts one true price, pays one small tax.
